symptom: Two F-B user feedback paths lost actionable output/diagnostics: (1) NF-1025-0001 Codex CLI local image generation reported bare 'Codex CLI 未产生可导入的生图文件。' whenever Codex emitted saved_path/result in JSONL, wrote inside workDir/nested subdirectories before workDir cleanup, or failed with turn.failed/error/stderr/agent refusal; (2) NF-1107-0002 Production Run reference upload localization overwrote HTTP 413 asset-too-large and channel failures with desktopT('assetUpload.hostingDisabled'), hiding which channel rejected the oversized file and stripping the multi-line summary needed by generationFailure.
direct_cause: electron/catalog/codexCli.ts only scanned a single flat directory ($CODEX_HOME/generated_images/<threadId>), deleted workDir on child close before persisting images written there, and describeCodexFailure ignored JSONL turn.failed/error/agent_message/non-zero stderr; electron/capabilityCore/productionReferenceUrls.ts caught all asset-upload-failed and asset-too-large errors from localizeForSend and replaced their message with desktopT('assetUpload.hostingDisabled').
class_root: Producer/transport wrappers discarded structured upstream facts at boundary handoffs: Codex CLI runner ignored structured JSONL image outputs and structured turn errors, while productionReferenceUrls flattened distinct upload channel failures into a single hardcoded hosting-disabled string.
affected_population: Users generating images via local Codex CLI whose output is reported via JSONL ImageGenerationItem saved_path/result, saved into workDir/nested directories, or rejected by Codex upstream errors/quota limits
Users running Production Run or Agent generation with oversized reference media (HTTP 413) or failing upload channels
entry_points: Codex local image generation completion & failure diagnostics (electron/catalog/codexCli.ts)
Production Run reference URL upload localization (electron/capabilityCore/productionReferenceUrls.ts)

external_sources.purpose: Confirm HTTP 413 Content Too Large semantics must be preserved as size-limit feedback rather than conflated with hosting-disabled policy.
Confirm Codex CLI exec --json JSONL event stream structure (ImageGenerationItem saved_path/result, turn.failed, error, agent_message).

invariants: resolveCodexGeneratedImage discovers images across JSONL ImageGenerationItem.saved_path, nested generated_images/<threadId> directories, non-input workDir outputs, and magic-byte-verified inline base64 results, persisting volatile outputs into codexJobsDir() before workDir is removed.

describeCodexFailure preserves structured JSONL turn.failed/error/image_generation failure reasons, non-zero stderr summaries, and agent_message refusals instead of collapsing them into a bare generic error.

localizeProductionReferenceUrls passes localizeForSend errors through intact so HTTP 413 asset-too-large summaries (channel, filename, byte size, newline) and AnonymousAssetConsentRequiredError each reach the renderer verbatim.

door_reduction.why_not: The two files own distinct production boundaries (local Codex CLI image runner vs Production Run reference URL upload localization); each boundary now preserves structured facts without adding parallel paths.

generality_proof: Centralizing Codex image discovery (saved_path, nested generated_images, workDir, validated base64) and structured failure extraction in codexCli.ts plus removing the blanket catch-and-rewrite in productionReferenceUrls.ts ensures every Codex output shape/error and every upload channel HTTP 413/5xx failure preserves truthful outcomes without touching assetLocalization.ts.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Single resolver discovering and staging Codex CLI generated images across JSONL saved_path, generated_images/<threadId>, workDir, and validated inline base64 before workDir cleanup.
Single failure narrator translating Codex CLI sentinels, JSONL turn.failed/error events, non-zero stderr, and agent refusals into actionable error copy.
Production Run reference URL localizer delegating to localizeForSend without overwriting asset-too-large or channel failure details.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Discovers images from saved_path, nested generated_images, workDir, and validated inline base64 before rmSync(workDir), and surfaces turn.failed/error/stderr/agent_message in describeCodexFailure.
Removed blanket .catch() that overwrote asset-too-large and asset-upload-failed with hostingDisabled; AnonymousAssetConsentRequiredError still carries hostingDisabled directly from localizeForSend.
Already produces structured multi-line asset-too-large and channel failure summaries and AnonymousAssetConsentRequiredError; left untouched per F-A step 2 coordination boundary.

recurrence.reason: Whenever Codex CLI updates its output layout/events or an upstream upload channel rejects oversized media with HTTP 413, lossy wrapper boundaries silently discard the real artifact or error details.
same_class_scan: Audited all 4 F-B user feedback paths (NF-1107-0001, NF-1107-0002, NF-1031-0001, NF-1025-0001) against origin/main
git grep assetUpload.hostingDisabled across electron/ identified productionReferenceUrls.ts blanket catch-and-overwrite on asset-too-large and asset-upload-failed
Inspected local codex-cli 0.171.0 binary ImageGenerationItem contract (saved_path, result, status, turn.failed) against electron/catalog/codexCli.ts

prevention.invariant: Codex image outputs are resolved via resolveCodexGeneratedImage before temp workDir cleanup, Codex failures preserve structured JSONL/stderr causes via describeCodexFailure, and productionReferenceUrls preserves localizeForSend errors verbatim.
prevention.failure_mode: Reintroducing a flat-only scan, deleting workDir before staging, or catching and replacing asset-too-large with hostingDisabled immediately fails the parameterized matrix tests in codexCli.test.ts and productionReferenceUrls.test.ts.
prevention.strategy: Enforce via parameterized matrix tests covering all four Codex output channels, four failure shapes, and three upload error preservation cases.

legacy_paths.rationale: Removed the destructive inline catch-and-overwrite in productionReferenceUrls.ts in the same commit (no standalone legacy file deleted); existing flat generated_images/<threadId> behavior remains supported as part of resolveCodexGeneratedImage.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Uses existing Node fs/Buffer and repo mediaTypes magic-byte validation without adding external dependencies.

migration: No user data migration required: existing Codex jobs and Production Run configs work transparently.
residual_risks: Live paid Codex CLI image generation against OpenAI servers was not executed (zero paid spend); local codex-cli 0.171.0 CLI flag parsing and binary ImageGenerationItem schema were verified alongside unit matrix tests.
